title: 静かな図書室
description: 無人の書架と閲覧席を、柔らかな午後光で収めた落ち着きのある素材です。
creator: @fuuuuuuma

tone.light: 高窓からの柔らかな午後光と弱い室内灯
tone.framing: 35mm・目線高・16:9。書架の反復で奥行きを作る
tone.texture: 紙、古い木、布張り、真鍮の小さな反射

pieces.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: cinematic B-roll still for video editing and thumbnails
Primary request: a long empty library aisle between tall wooden bookshelves, fading into soft afternoon shadow
Scene/backdrop: modest public reading library near closing time, completely unoccupied
Subject: repeating shelves, varied books with unreadable spines, and aisle perspective, no living subject
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial interior photography, natural imperfections, subtle fine film grain
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, eye-level, 35mm lens, centered medium-wide view with calm depth
Lighting/mood: soft high-window daylight mixed with dim practical lights, 4000K, studious quiet mood
Color palette: dark honey wood, muted paper cream, olive gray
Materials/textures: worn book cloth, aged paper edges, wood grain, brushed brass
Constraints: one coherent real photograph; no people, no faces, no hands, no silhouettes, no readable book titles, no readable text, no logos, no brands, no watermark
Avoid: fantasy library, luxury palace, magical light, moving ladders, illustration, CGI look, oversaturation
